Clinicians should be trained not only in the technical use of these systems but also in communication practices that support transparency, address patient concerns, and maintain professional accountability for clinical records.
Structured feedback mechanisms — including surveys, focus groups, and incident reporting — should inform ongoing re finements to consent procedures, data governance policies, and clinical protocols.
